title: Wabash Kiwanis Trivia Fundraiser for Riley Children’s Health
description:
Who? Wabash Kiwanis Club
What? Trivia Fundraiser for Riley Children's Health
When? Friday, August 28; Doors open at 6:30P; Event at 7:30P
Where? Wabash Elks Lodge (NW corner of Market and Cass streets)
How? Registration will take place closer to the date
Why? To support Kiwanis’ and Riley’s missions for kids
• Guests must be 18 years or older to attend
• 8 rounds of 10 questions
• Drinks and food available at Wabash Elks Lodge
• A part of Wabash Founders Festival weekend
